catalog.name: Cygnus X-1
catalog.description: Prototype stellar-mass black hole accreting matter from blue supergiant companion HDE 226868 via focused stellar wind.

catalog.name: Crab Pulsar
catalog.description: Young neutron star created in SN 1054 supernova with extremely stable 33 ms double-peaked pulsed profile across all bands.

catalog.name: GRS 1915+105
catalog.description: Rapidly spinning Kerr black hole displaying superluminal radio jets and persistent low-frequency quasi-periodic oscillations.

catalog.name: V404 Cygni
catalog.description: Black hole transient exhibiting extreme sub-hour optical and X-ray outbursts driven by disk instability mechanisms.

catalog.name: MAXI J1820+070
catalog.description: Fast-rising X-ray binary discovered in 2018 with contracted corona geometry during state transitions.

catalog.name: Her X-1
catalog.description: Eclipsing intermediate mass binary with 1.24 second spin pulsations and a 35-day accretion disk precession cycle.

catalog.name: Sco X-1
catalog.description: Brightest non-solar X-ray source in the sky, exhibiting characteristic Z-track color-color diagram morphology.

catalog.name: Vela X-1
catalog.description: Massive neutron star (1.88 solar masses) deeply embedded in intense stellar wind of B0.5Ib supergiant HD 77581.

catalog.name: 4U 1820-30
catalog.description: Ultra-compact binary located in globular cluster NGC 6624 with shortest known binary orbital period (11.4 minutes).

catalog.name: Cen X-3
catalog.description: First X-ray pulsar discovered in space history (UHURU satellite), exhibiting clear periodic Doppler spin variations.
